solution.name: Living Suitcase
solution.scope: Reproducible, independently governed community capability blueprints from reclaimed hardware, with consent-based coordination and offline-first deployment
solution.initial_question: Can one community document a functional low-cost offline computer node well enough for a second independent community to reproduce its capabilities with less expense and operator burden?
solution.public_pitch: A finished object is one useful thing. A tested blueprint helps another community make one of its own.

opportunity.date_conflict_note: Some pages of official application PDF retain Nov 2; live challenge and PDF cover say Nov 6. Verify live portal before submitting.
opportunity.program: Competitive solver selection and resources; application itself carries no award.

application.stage_gate: Concept-stage projects are excluded from Global Challenge review; evidence of solution-level functioning prototype is needed.

pilot.setting: Two independent operators reproduce an offline local computer node from a documented reclaimed-hardware blueprint; food logistics is a downstream possible service pilot

next_human_gates: Reviewer establishes whether the actual integrated proposed solution is Prototype rather than Concept for 2027 Global Challenge eligibility
User personally revises and authorizes application language, media and legal/organizational status
Owner makes a safe, redacted hardware inventory; no unattended or destructive installation
First operator completes physical local network and recovery tests with objective evidence
First operator documents a versioned blueprint and safety/compatibility constraints
Independent second operator repeats the declared functions on a separate build
Independent reviewer records successes, failures, costs, maintenance and rights limits
Separate local steward agrees to any later real food/resource distribution experiment
Applicant manually submits before confirmed deadline

current_baseline.label: Living Suitcase / Mattercraft / Blueprint Foundry
current_baseline.first_object: Independently operated offline-capable local computer/phone/router node made from suitably verified reclaimed equipment
current_baseline.hypothesis: Build instructions with exact parts, compatible substitutions, held evidence and independent retest may reduce setup cost and improve community-owned repairability
technical_steps: assemble and test one particular object
capture exact build inputs, failures and bounded receipt

separate stewardship review and local federation
